# chainlink-v2.10.0

`src/v0.6/` holds Chainlink's `EACAggregatorProxy.sol` and the six files it imports, copied unchanged from github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink at tag v2.10.0 (commit `0fe651463fbfa323ed4c578756c5a1465e0b168d`), `contracts/src/v0.6/`; v2.10.0 is the last release whose tree still carries the v0.6 data-feed proxy. Licence MIT (SPDX header of each file). Built by the `chainlink-proxy` profile (Solidity 0.6.6) for test-network deployments only.
